name: David J. Beck
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Houston, Texas
education: The University of Texas School of Law
about: David J. Beck is an attorney who represents clients in the Houston, Texas area. David Beck is recognized by peers and was selected to Super Lawyers for 2003 - 2026. This selection is based off of an evaluation of 12 indicators including peer recognition and professional achievement in legal practice.

David Beck chose to pursue a career in law after completing undergraduate studies. He attended The University of Texas School of Law and graduated in 1965. David Beck passed the bar exam and was admitted to legal practice in 1964.
He represents clients with Business Litigation issues in Texas. He also represents clients with Civil Litigation: Defense and General Litigation issues.

Being selected to Super Lawyers is limited to a small number of attorneys in each state. As one of the few attorneys to garner the distinction of Super Lawyers, David Beck has earned the respect of peers as one of the top-rated attorneys in the nation.
